description: A typed Drizzle ORM database over any SQLite driver: one lock, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions, drizzle-kit migrations at open, typed Preferences and a hardened export envelope.
rules: Use database.transaction(fn) and the tx it provides; never db.transaction, which is refused.
Inside transaction(fn), use tx, not db: db waits for the lock the transaction holds.
Every writer on the connection goes through the database: db, transaction, exclusive or guardSnapshots.
Never edit a shipped migration; generate a new one. Opening refuses drift and unknown applied migrations.
Export the domain value in an envelope, not table rows.
